[tag notes]
  T_ABS      ABS(K_NUM)                     ; r4numDoub, no new key route | built
  T_INT      INT(K_NUM)                     ; r4numDoub, truncation direction on both signs | built
  T_ROUND    ROUND(K_NUM,1)                 ; r4numDoub, the rounding rule STR also raises | built
  T_MOD      MOD(K_NUM,3)                   ; r4numDoub, sign of the result on a negative operand | built
  T_MIN      MIN(K_NUM,100)                 ; r4numDoub | built
  T_MAX      MAX(K_NUM,100)                 ; r4numDoub | built
  T_SQRT     SQRT(ABS(K_NUM))               ; r4numDoub; ABS inside because SQRT of a negative raises | built
  T_SIGN     SIGN(K_NUM)                    ; r4numDoub | built
  T_LEN      LEN(K_TEXT)                    ; r4numDoub over a character operand | built
  T_AT       AT("A",K_TEXT)                 ; r4numDoub, two character operands | built
  T_ASC      ASC(K_TEXT+" ")                ; r4numDoub; the pad keeps ASC off an empty string, which raises | built
  T_LOWER    LOWER(K_TEXT)                  ; r4str, result length is the operand's -- expect keyLen 20 | built
  T_REPL     REPLICATE(K_TEXT,2)            ; r4str, result length is n x operand -- expect keyLen 40 | built
  T_PROPER   PROPER(K_TEXT)                 ; r4str, beyond the thirteen; length should follow the operand | built
  T_STRTRN   STRTRAN(K_TEXT,"A","BB")       ; r4str with a value-dependent length -- how does VFP size it? | REFUSED: Error building key for index "vfpfunc.cdx" tag "T_strtrn".
  T_VTRIM    TRIM(K_TEXT)                   ; shared name; CodeBase returns source width NUL-padded | built
  T_VSTR     STR(K_NUM,12,3)                ; shared name; CodeBase rounds half away from zero (ADR-43 open) | built
  T_UPPER    UPPER(K_TEXT)                  ; shared name, the control row -- this one must agree | built
